tiers.text: Ask: 'Use the review-code skill to review the code since start against PLAN.md. Rank the findings and paste them into the table in REVIEW.md, most severe first. Don't fix anything.'
Triage the top three to five: does each matter for a prototype? FIX, ACCEPT or REJECT, and one line why. The rest can wait.
Fix one FIX item with a test that fails first, run make test, commit. Then the next, if there is time.
